title: Breath — Invisible Force, Visible Consequence
subtitle: Air made legible through drifting smoke, curtains, vapor, and wind-driven blades
lineage: Lineage: Daniel Mercadante / The Mercadantes, Breath (music by Keith Kenniff)
theorem: Make an invisible action legible through its effects on surfaces, objects, and other actions, then shape a film's duration around unequal expansion and release.
boundary_note: The rotating mechanical windmill/fan is shown before its shape match with settling fabric so the edit never claims human breath caused mechanical airflow.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #02 (t=03.50s-06.30s): `08e49d0e` shows a Federal Reserve binder.
Seg #03 (t=06.30s-11.80s): `8b708c95` shows an animated US map.
Seg #04 (t=11.80s-17.30s): `ec252218` shows the Golden Gate Bridge tower.
Seg #05 (t=17.30s-23.80s): `f6022bfe` cuts internally at t=19.77s to industrial pipes.
Seg #06 (t=23.80s-29.60s): `af2f58ac` shows exterior high-voltage transmission towers.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Seg #02-#06 suffered OpenCLIP hallucinations (binder, US map, bridge, pipes, power towers) instead of visible air/vapor/breath effects and a rotating blade/fan.
critic_tribunal.causal_hypothesis: OpenCLIP keyword/visual hallucination matching abstract air terms to unrelated macro archival shots.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Replace Seg #02-#06 with human-verified Cineosis shots of visible air, vapor, curtains, and wind-driven blades: `a7a91170` (`0.05s-3.00s`, pale smoke/breath drifting), `8b6bda0f` (`0.2s-5.7s`, smoke billowing in air), `491529e4` (`0.5s-6.0s`, white curtains by window), `005ac24d` (`2.5s-8.5s`, dense vapor/condensation cloud), and `1f64ac90` (`0.05s-2.05s`, mechanical windmill blades turning in wind) followed by `76aee35d` settling.
critic_tribunal.strength_to_preserve: The quiet high-contrast window frame at the close (`d73d8647`, `Medicus Collection`, 1939), holding still architectural space after airflow subsides.
